applyTo: "**/*.md"

# Markdown Style (markdownlint)

All Markdown files must comply with [markdownlint](https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint) default rules. Key rules to follow:

- **MD001**: Heading levels must increment by one (no skipping from `#` to `###`).
- **MD003**: Use ATX-style headings (`# Heading`, not underline style).
- **MD009**: No trailing spaces on lines.
- **MD010**: No hard tabs; use spaces for indentation.
- **MD012**: No multiple consecutive blank lines.
- **MD013**: Keep line length reasonable (prefer under 120 characters where practical).
- **MD022**: Headings must be surrounded by blank lines.
- **MD023**: Headings must start at the beginning of the line.
- **MD025**: Only one top-level heading (`#`) per file.
- **MD031**: Fenced code blocks must be surrounded by blank lines.
- **MD032**: Lists must be surrounded by blank lines.
- **MD033**: Inline HTML must not be used (e.g., use Markdown syntax instead of `<br>`).
- **MD034**: Bare URLs must be enclosed in angle brackets (e.g., `<http://example.com>`).
- **MD035**: Horizontal rules must be a consistent style (e.g., `---`).
- **MD036**: Emphasis used instead of a header (e.g., use `# Heading` instead of `*Heading*`).
- **MD047**: Files must end with a single newline character.
- **MD048**: Code fence style must be consistent (use backticks ``` for code blocks).
- **MD049**: Code block style must be consistent (use fenced code blocks, not indented).
- **MD050**: No more than three consecutive blank lines.
- **MD051**: No more than one consecutive blank line at the end of a file
- **MD052**: No more than one consecutive blank line at the beginning of a file.
- **MD053**: All link definitions must be at the end of the document.
- **MD054**: Link text must not contain formatting (e.g., no bold or italic text in link text).
- **MD055**: Proper names must be capitalized (e.g., "GitHub", not "github").
- **MD056**: All HTML elements must be closed (e.g., `<br>` should be `<br />`).
- **MD057**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD058**: No duplicate definitions (e.g., no duplicate link definitions).
- **MD059**: Use consistent spacing after list markers (e.g., `- Item` instead of `-Item`).
- **MD060**: No lazy continuations (e.g., avoid breaking a list item across multiple lines without proper indentation).
- **MD061**: No non-standard ordered list marker (e.g., use `1.`, `2.`, etc., instead of `1)`, `2)`, etc.).
- **MD062**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD063**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD064**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD065**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD066**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD067**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD068**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD069**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD070**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD071**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD072**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD073**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD074**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD075**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD076**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD077**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
- **MD078**: No bare URLs (use angle brackets `<http://example.com>` or link syntax `[Example](http://example.com)`).
- **MD079**: No trailing punctuation in link text (e.g., `[Example](http://example.com)` instead of `[Example.](http://example.com)`).
